questions.prompt: What should be in scope for the cost model?
questions.description: Based on roadmap: estimate LLM cost, PDF processing cost, storage, bandwidth, infra, support. Calculate cost per paper, gross margin, max free-tier abuse.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All cost drivers: Gemini API calls, PDF extraction, SQLite storage, bandwidth, server infra, support overhead. Model by operation type.

questions.prompt: Which operations should have individual cost models?
questions.description: Roadmap says: single-paper analysis, figure analysis, comparison, bulk analysis, API, MCP
questions.recommendedAnswer: Single-paper analysis, figure analysis, paper comparison. API/MCP deferred until those features ship.

questions.prompt: What format should the cost model take?
questions.description: Document, spreadsheet-like markdown table, or interactive dashboard?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Markdown document with tables — fits existing docs/ pattern, version-controlled, easy to update.

questions.prompt: Should the cost model include tier-specific (Free/Pro/Research) margin analysis?
questions.description: Compare cost-to-serve vs assumed revenue per tier
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes — margin analysis per tier validates whether current tier limits are economically viable.
